template.title: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
template.governing_standard: LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP
template.typical_review_timeline: 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close)

fields.label: Corporate Borrower & Operating Jurisdiction
fields.description: Borrower entity, sector, and primary market.

fields.label: Recommended Sustainable Finance Structure (Green Loan / SLL / Green Bond / Trade Finance)
fields.description: Matches requested financing size and type to the bank's sustainable finance product suite.

fields.label: Taxonomy & Market Standards Alignment (EU Taxonomy / ICMA GBP / LMA GLP)
fields.description: Maps project use-of-proceeds to eligible green taxonomy categories.

fields.label: Proposed Sustainability Performance Targets (SPTs) & Decarbonization KPIs
fields.description: Measurable GHG intensity or absolute tCO2e reduction KPIs tied to margin ratchet or green reporting.

fields.label: Second-Party Opinion (SPO) & Independent Assurance Readiness
fields.description: Verifies whether an external SPO (e.g., Sustainalytics, ISS, S&P Shades of Green) is already obtained or required.

fields.label: Sector Exclusion & ESG Risk Screening
fields.description: Checks fossil fuel expansion exclusions and environmental permitting.

fields.label: Credit Profile (Revenue, EBITDA, Capex, Expected IRR)
fields.description: Borrower financial capacity for corporate or project finance underwriting.

fields.label: Detailed Use of Proceeds & Transition Plan Summary
fields.description: Comprehensive transition finance rationale grounded in the bank's COP31 sustainable finance strategy.
